🎁 FREE GAME ALERT: Amazon Prime Gaming (Luna) is giving away WRC Generations and Jurassic World Evolution 2 — free to keep.

🏎️ WRC Generations has been claimable since Nov 5.
🦖 Jurassic World Evolution 2 joined the lineup on Nov 12.
🔑 Claim via the Luna claims page with an active Amazon Prime subscription — codes redeem on the Epic Games Store, and claimed games stay yours even after Prime ends.
⏳ Deadlines: WRC Generations by Dec 9, Jurassic World Evolution 2 by Dec 16.

🕐 Posted: 19:54 GMT+3

📰 Sources: Video Games Chronicle, SteamDB

💬 Grabbing both, or just one? Let us know below!

#PrimeGaming #FreeGames #AmazonLuna #Giveaway #GamingNews
